title: CmdPal: Add a new tray icon menu

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The latest change connects the tray-icon click-action setting to settings search: its catalog entry, General-page destination, target ID, resource names and added search/breadcrumb test cases agree. The earlier missing-enum issue is fixed. The previous optional double-click concern was not established as a defect.

**Validation scope:** Exact-head source consistency and XML parsing passed. The added test cases were inspected, not executed; no new compiled test run or interactive tray/settings-search validation is claimed. This is a qualified assessment of the accumulated review and latest integration change, not an unconditional approval.
